caller_is_authorized.meaning: the caller of rebalanceFunds() is an authorized caller (not an arbitrary user)

rebalance_invoked.meaning: rebalanceFunds() was invoked by the caller

vault_undercollateralized_after_rebalanc.meaning: after the rebalanceFunds() call the vault is temporarily under-collateralized such that other redemptions might fail

reentrancy_guard_present.meaning: rebalanceFunds() has a nonReentrant guard around its external custodian transfer

custodian_is_contract.meaning: the custodian address is a contract and ERC777 or callback-enabled tokens are in use

assumptions: rebalanceFunds() performs an external _vaultToken.transfer(custodian, excess) call.
A prior redemption via processTransfer() may have reduced the vault balance before the rebalanceFunds() call.
The custodian address may be a contract and ERC777 or callback-enabled tokens may be in use.

unresolved.description: Report does not establish that a prior processTransfer() redemption occurred before the rebalanceFunds() call; the under-collateralization scenario is only potential.
Report does not give numeric collateralization thresholds or vault balance values; under-collateralization is represented as a grounded Boolean observable.

limitations: The access-control intent is formalized against the race_undercollateralized impact only; other impacts are handled in separate passes.
The under-collateralization observable is a report-grounded Boolean because no numeric collateral ratio is supplied.
The condition encodes the unauthorized-caller scenario; the report's general requirement is that rebalanceFunds() be restricted to authorized callers.
